summary: A single-line text field, together with its label, helper text and error message.
useWhen: collecting one line of free text
the field needs a label, helper text, or validation messaging

useInstead.when: the user picks from a fixed set of options

useInstead.why: country code and formatting are handled for you

trailingIcon.note: decorative unless it is interactive, in which case it needs its own button and name

leadingAddon.note: a static prefix such as a protocol or currency; not focusable

guarantees: ids are generated and wired — the label points at the input via aria-labelledby
aria-describedby points at whichever of the helper text or error message is actually showing
requires: `label`, or `aria-label` when the field is visually self-evident and no label is rendered
notes: The label/helper/error wrapper is only rendered when there is something to put in it — Figma models it as a separate `Form Field` component, this does not.

antiPatterns.why: the placeholder disappears on focus, so the user loses the field's name exactly when typing
the component generates the id; an external htmlFor will not match it

antiPatterns.dont: showing an error by putting the message in `description`
antiPatterns.why: only errorMessage drives aria-invalid and the described-by wiring
